source: JLCPCB parts library page https://jlcpcb.com/partdetail/C89826 read 2026-11-11 (Texas Instruments LP2985A-33DBVR, package SOT-23-5, library type Extended) ; LCSC product record for C89826 (the data behind https://www.lcsc.com/product-detail/C89826.html, fetched from wmsc.lcsc.com/ftps/wm/product/detail?productCode=C89826) read 2026-11-11 (TI LP2985A-33DBVR, SOT-23-5, 3.3V fixed LDO, 150 mA, input up to 16 V, enable, bypass pin; listed stock 16510) ; datasheet: TI LP2985 150-mA Low-noise Low-dropout Regulator With Shutdown, SLVS522O (July 2004, revised January 2015; the PDF of https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/f4c8079586e64814b5504c7ebc6ada82.pdf, 28 pages, SHA-256 6dd8a7c7bcb8): section 6.5 Electrical Characteristics, printed page 5, columns LP2985A-xx (output voltage tolerance for 1 mA <= IL <= 150 mA over -40 C to 125 C: +/-3.5 %; dropout voltage at IL = 150 mA over -40 C to 125 C: 575 mV max, 350 mV at 25 C); section 6.3 Recommended Operating Conditions (IOUT 150 mA max; TJ -40 C to 125 C; VIN 2.2 V to 16 V); section 5 pin functions (printed page 3) ; the number is the LCSC property of U2 of the charger module's board file (reference/charger-module.kicad_pcb)
notes: Texas Instruments. **The board's schematic and BOM call the part LP2985-3.3 (the 1.5 % grade); the number it carries, C89826, is the LP2985A-33DBVR, the A grade (1 %).** The LCSC and JLCPCB records and the datasheet's A-grade columns agree. vout.voltage is the A grade's tolerance over the whole load and temperature range (+/-3.5 %: +/-1 % holds only at 25 C and 1 mA, +/-2.5 % at 1 to 50 mA over temperature, +/-1.5 % at 25 C to 150 mA). dropout is the maximum over temperature at the full 150 mA. max_current is 0.15 A. No max_power: the datasheet gives the thermal resistance (206 C/W, DBV, section 6.4) and the formula PD = (TJ(max) - TA) / RthJA, not a power figure, so the regulator's power check is not evaluated (about 0.49 W at 25 C ambient with a 125 C junction by that formula, which is not entered). The quiescent current is stated in the part (0 to 125 uA unloaded, 2.5 mA at 150 mA over temperature). temp_min and temp_max are the recommended virtual junction range (TJ), not an ambient one. The Vin range (2.2 V to 16 V) is not a catalog column. Price not recorded. Pins: src/lp2985.nsm.
